name: gmail-multi
description: Search, read, draft, and send across SEVERAL Gmail accounts at once — the managed Gmail connector binds to one account; this one covers them all in a single query, tags every result with its mailbox, fetches attachments, creates reviewable drafts, and can send, reply, and forward from whichever account you name (consumers with a draft-only policy, like jobsearch, deny the send tools with their own guard). Standalone: configure accounts with its own /gmail-multi:accounts command; app passwords stay in the OS credential store and are never seen by Claude. Use it whenever mail spans more than one Google account.

metadata.versioningPolicy: Explicit releases; minor per behaviour change, patch per fix. Bump before any sync or push — an unbumped change ships nothing and looks like a broken install.
metadata.provides: MCP server gmail-multi (8 gmail_* tools: 5 read/draft + send/reply/forward). Contracts: adr-004-gmail-connector-extraction.md
